records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the 2023 first quarter, approximately 55% of KMT inland revenues were under term contracts and 45% were spot contract revenues.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consequently, KMT is directly affected by the volumes produced by the Company’s petroleum, petrochemical, and refining customer base.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increases for the 2023 first quarter were primarily due to higher term and spot pricing and increased tank barge utilization in the inland and coastal markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Also, the 2022 first quarter was impacted by the COVID-19 Omicron variant as increased cases among the Company’s mariners led to crewing challenges, lost revenue and increased operating costs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities for the 2023 first quarter decreased in comparison to the 2022 first quarter primarily due to an increase in working capital, partially offset by improved net earnings.
